interpretation: The 52-byte payload matches the layout and signature of the 13-DWORD VS_FIXEDFILEINFO structure defined in the DOS 6 reference toolchain header. Its length prefix equals the entire structure size.
limits: Structure identity is strongly supported by signature, size and fields, but its original source declaration and callers are not yet recovered.
The trailing file OS value 0x0000000a is recorded as-is; the referenced header does not assign it a named value.
The index pointer and length do not alone prove physical allocation ownership or whether consumers request ID 9900.
